------
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY ------
For the Petitioner : Md. Zaid Ahmed, Advocate For the State : Mr. Anup Pawan Topno, Addl. P.P.
For the Informant : Mr. R.N. Chatterjee, Advocate : Mr. Diksha Rani, Advocate ------

Order No.04 Dated- 10.11.2023 Heard the parties.
The petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of regular bail in connection with S.T.
Case No. 96 of 2023 arising out of Mandu (W.B.) P.S. Case No.16 of 2021 registered under sections 376/506 of the Indian Penal Code.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner has committed rape upon the prosecutrix and captured the sexual act by a video and threatening the prosecutrix to make the same viral and the petitioner thereafter continuously committed rape upon the victim and also caused her miscarriage without her consent by administering medicine to her.
It is further submitted that the allegation against the petitioner are all false and there is an inordinate delay in lodging the F.I.R.
It is then submitted that the petitioner has been in custody since 25.04.2023 as has been mentioned in paragraph no. 16 of the bail application.
It is next submitted that the petitioner undertakes to cooperate with the trial of the case.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioner be admitted to bail.
The learned Addl. P.P. opposes the prayer for bail.
Considering the submissions of the counsels and the fact as discussed above, I am inclined to enlarge the above named petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-
